metadata.question: Were Shebelle River's levels higher on May 9, 2018 in comparison to May 17,2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-1 SAR data to detect water levels (SAR can penetrate clouds and is good for water detection) - Shebelle River is in Somalia/Ethiopia region - Compare two specific dates: May 9, 2018 vs May 17, 2015 - Sentinel-1 data available from 2014 onwards 2. Masking strategy: - For water detection, use VV or VH polarization - Lower backscatter values indicate water - Will calculate mean backscatter over river area - higher water levels = lower backscatter (more water surface) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check if images exist for both dates (C1 if missing) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2 if zero pixels) - Verify backscatter values are in valid range (typically -30 to 10 dB for SAR) - Higher water level = lower backscatter value - Answer A if 2018 backscatter < 2015 backscatter (more water in 2018) - Answer B if 2018 backscatter >= 2015 backscatter (less or equal water in 2018) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions - Shebelle River area in Somalia const shebelleRiver = ee.Geometry.Point([45.3, 2.0]).buffer(5000); // ~10km diameter area const date2018 = '2018-05-09'; const date2015 = '2015-05-17'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection const col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(shebelleRiver) .filterDate(date2018, ee.Date(date2018).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const col2015 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(shebelleRiver) .filterDate(date2015, ee.Date(date2015).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); const size2015 = col2015.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Images: ${size2018}`); console.log(`2015 Images: ${size2015}`); // Check for missing data - try wider date range if needed if (size2018 === 0 || size2015 === 0) { // Try 3-day window const col2018_wider = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(shebelleRiver) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2018).advance(-1, 'day'), ee.Date(date2018).advance(2, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const col2015_wider = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(shebelleRiver) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2015).advance(-1, 'day'), ee.Date(date2015).advance(2, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size2018_w = col2018_wider.size().getInfo(); const size2015_w = col2015_wider.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Wider search - 2018: ${size2018_w}, 2015: ${size2015_w}`); if (size2018_w === 0 || size2015_w === 0) { console.log('No data found even with wider date range'); console.log('C1'); return; } var img2018 = col2018_wider.first(); var img2015 = col2015_wider.first(); } else { var img2018 = col2018.first(); var img2015 = col2015.first(); } // 3. Processing - Calculate backscatter statistics const stats2018 = img2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: shebelleRiver, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2015 = img2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: shebelleRiver, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2018 = stats2018.get('VV_mean').getInfo(); const count2018 = stats2018.get('VV_count').getInfo(); const mean2015 = stats2015.get('VV_mean').getInfo(); const count2015 = stats2015.get('VV_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2018: Mean=${mean2018}, Pixels=${count2018}`); console.log(`2015: Mean=${mean2015}, Pixels=${count2015}`); // 4. Validation if (count2018 === 0 || count2015 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean2018 === null || mean2015 === null || isNaN(mean2018) || isNaN(mean2015)) { console.log('Invalid calculation results'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if values are in valid SAR range if (mean2018 < -35 || mean2018 > 10 || mean2015 < -35 || mean2015 > 10) { console.log('Values outside valid SAR range'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Final Answer - Lower backscatter = more water = higher level const diff = mean2018 - mean2015; console.log(`Backscatter difference (2018-2015): ${diff.toFixed(2)} dB`); if (mean2018 < mean2015) { console.log('2018 had lower backscatter = higher water levels'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2018 had higher/equal backscatter = lower/equal water levels'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
